## Call analytics FAQs
What's the difference between call reporting and queue analytics? 
Call reporting (CDR) covers every call your organization makes and receives â€” history, call accounting, and compliance. Queue analytics focuses on calls routed through queues, hunt groups, and auto attendants â€” wait times, abandon rates, agent performance, and service levels. ISI offers both, and many customers start with one and add the other. 
Which UC platforms does ISI support? 
ISI provides call analytics for Microsoft Teams, Webex Calling, Cisco UCM/UCCX, and Avaya â€” including mixed environments during a migration. 
Do I need a contact center platform to get call-center-grade reporting? 
No. ISI delivers contact-center-grade queue and call reporting on top of your existing Teams or Webex queues, without the cost or complexity of deploying a full contact center. 
How much does ISI cost? 
Pricing depends on platform, call volume, and modules. See pricing or talk to our team â€” most customers are surprised it costs far less than a contact center platform.

## Call analytics FAQs
What's the difference between call reporting and queue analytics? 
Call reporting (CDR) covers every call your organization makes and receives — history, call accounting, and compliance. Queue analytics focuses on calls routed through queues, hunt groups, and auto attendants — wait times, abandon rates, agent performance, and service levels. ISI offers both, and many customers start with one and add the other. 
Which UC platforms does ISI support? 
ISI provides call analytics for Microsoft Teams, Webex Calling, Cisco UCM/UCCX, and Avaya — including mixed environments during a migration. 
Do I need a contact center platform to get call-center-grade reporting? 
No. ISI delivers contact-center-grade queue and call reporting on top of your existing Teams or Webex queues, without the cost or complexity of deploying a full contact center. 
How much does ISI cost? 
Pricing depends on platform, call volume, and modules. See pricing or talk to our team — most customers are surprised it costs far less than a contact center platform.
